bubble

components · 0.3.0 · v4 C2 · aj-c-bubble

A message in Ask: yours, a bubble on the right with its tail at the lower right, or the answer, a wider bubble on the left with its tail at the lower left. The answer's dates are its references (each opens that day), "n entries used" lists the entries under it, and its tools sit inside it; yours sit under it. With a mouse the tools fade in on hover or focus.

statedefaultyes: the bubble, its words, its tools (shown with touch; at rest with a mouse they are hidden until hover or focus)
statehoveryes: with a mouse, the tools fade in (180ms); a reference or an entry used darkens to --block
statefocus-visibleyes: focus inside shows the tools; a reference, a tool, the summary and an entry used take the product's ring
stateactiven/a: the tools and links carry their own press
statedisabledyes: yours unsent: dimmed and dashed, "Not sent", no tools
stateselectedyes: a set bookmark or thumb stays shown, filled (bookmark --rule, up --rate-up, down --rate-down)
stateloadingyes: the answer reading (the reading line) and writing (the words arriving, the rest waiting)
stateerroryes: the answer cant: dashed and unfilled, flagged "Not in your journal", the next line, no thumbs
stateemptyn/a: a message always has words; an empty session is the composer's lead

Yours

Your message: on the right, its tail at the lower right; bookmark and copy under it (with a mouse they fade in on hover).

What do I write about when I can’t sleep?

Answer

The answer: wider, on the left; the dates are its references (each opens that day); “2 entries used”; the tools inside it.

Sleep comes up in eleven of your entries since June. Nine of them were written after ten at night (6 Aug), and most are less about the night than about the next day: work you haven’t started, a call you keep putting off.

The nights you slept well, you had been out walking first (3 Jul).
